description: Generator Gen B would not start after a full inspection: air filter OK, oil changed, cracked fuel line replaced.
response: Battery required an overnight charge before the engine would turn over. Started successfully on Day 5.
lesson: Battery charge is the last triage step — easy to overlook after mechanical work. Always include an overnight charge cycle as a final step before declaring a generator unserviceable.
pattern_tag: generator battery charge as final triage step
